title: rhobound CLI refusal
description: What a CLI command prints on standard output with --json when it refuses (bad data, out of scope, an unknown service, an unsupported operation), exit status 1 as for predict, infer and model today (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.8). The server returns the same Refusal object in a tool result with isError: true. The code is a fixed token from the registry; anything derived from data is in the sanitized subject.
